uslaw-usc-t2-s142j:
Section 142j of Title 2 of the United States Code lets the Library of Congress provide money services for the John C Stennis Center for Public Service Training and Development. From 1 October 1988, the Library may pay out funds appropriated for the Center. It may also work out and pay the basic pay of all Center staff.

The Library may further give the Center financial management services and support. The model is the like support given to the Office of Technology Assessment under a named section. The Library collects the full costs of these services from the Center's appropriated funds. The charging follows an agreement for services ordered under two named sections of Title 31.
